definitions.explanation: Knowledge or skills in a particular field acquired through study or experience. Used in professional and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {専門知識|せんもんちしき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{彼女|かのじょ}はITの{専門知識|せんもんちしき}を{持|も}っている。
この{仕事|しごと}には{法律|ほうりつ}の{専門知識|せんもんちしき}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: This job requires specialized knowledge of law.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {専門|せんもん} (specialty) and {知識|ちしき} (knowledge). Very common in job listings, business contexts, and academic discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}を{持|も}つ: to have expertise
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}を{身|み}につける: to acquire expertise
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}が{必要|ひつよう}: expertise is required
- {専門知識|せんもんちしき}を{活|い}かす: to put expertise to use
